summary: Evotec SE furnished its Half-Year Interim Report 2026 on Form 6-K, alongside a corporate news release detailing second-quarter and first-half results. The filing covers routine financial updates, including a 19.2% revenue decline to €300.1 million, adjusted EBITDA of -€42.7 million, and an updated FY2026 outlook. It also lists ordinary business developments, grants, collaborations, and standard governance changes like a CFO appointment and board elections. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, spin-off, or activist campaign is present. The filing is a routine interim report announcement with no transactional or strategic restructuring event requiring special-situations classification.
